title: Initial finite replacement stage
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X and an etale hypercover K [def-weil-pbc-etale-hypercover], there exists a finite split replacement stage through degree zero [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage].

source.place: 01GJ, degree-zero refinement; 0DAV, initial stage; 094K, finite affine choices.

proof.text: The matching universal property in degree zero has no projections. Apply it to the identity of X to obtain a section of the structure map of the matching object. Consequently that structure map is surjective. Its composite with the surjective matching arrow of K is the structure map of K_0, hence K_0 covers X.

Regard K_0 to X as a one-member etale cover. Images of its affine opens are open. Compactness of X selects finitely many covering images, by QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact. Take the corresponding affine Spec schemes as W_i. They are qcqs and their etale structure maps to X are locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

Take T to be the coproduct of the W_i in the etale over category. The coproduct injections and selected covering images show that T to X is surjective. The induced T to K_0 defines a constant degree-zero truncated object and its refinement map. There is exactly one surjection from a retained degree to degree zero; its cofan is the identity colimit. Take T as N_0 and the identity as inclusion; use X as the empty matching limit. These data give the required stage.
